notes: The owner: "cash is very slow but eventually returns, can you look and see if we have an addressible performance problem." There was one, and it was structural. /pf/get priced the whole book before it answered anything — one live quote per distinct position, 22 for his book, timed end to end at 11.7 seconds. The Cash view shares a renderer with Holdings and therefore shared that fetch, so it waited on twenty-two network round trips to print a cash balance that depends on none of them. 5.75.0 made it worse, and that is a cost of the architecture rather than a coincidence.
